question: Keď Slováci hľadajú lacné letenky, často letia „z Viedne“. Viedenské letisko však v skutočnosti neleží vo Viedni. V ktorom meste sa nachádza?
source_excerpt: located in Schwechat, 18 km (11 mi) southeast of central Vienna and 57 kilometres (35 mi) west of Bratislava

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks routinely say they fly 'from Vienna' for cheap tickets, assuming the airport is in Vienna. It actually sits in a separate town in another Austrian state, and the town's name is printed on road signs most of them have driven past.
extra.verification_notes: Vienna International Airport is in Schwechat, Lower Austria, not in Vienna proper (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vienna_International_Airport).

explanation: Letisko leží v meste Schwechat v Dolnom Rakúsku, teda dokonca v inej spolkovej krajine ako Viedeň. Preto mu mnohí Rakúšania hovoria jednoducho „Schwechat“.

question: Bratislavské letisko, odkiaľ štartujú lacné lety k moru, nesie meno muža, ktorý zahynul pri páde lietadla len pár kilometrov od miesta, kde dnes letisko stojí. Kto to bol?
topic: Letisko M. R. Štefánika v Bratislave
source_excerpt: the aircraft went down close to Ivanka pri Dunaji on Sunday, 4 May 1919

extra.why_interesting: Everyone knows the airport's name but rarely connects it to the fact that its namesake died in a plane crash only a few kilometres from the runways. The stem gives enough footholds for any Slovak to reason their way to the answer.
extra.verification_notes: Štefánik died in the 4 May 1919 plane crash near Ivanka pri Dunaji, close to the airport that still bears his name (no renaming found as of 2026); source: https://www.mod.gov.sk/41797-en/rezort-obrany-si-uctil-pamiatku-gen-m-r-stefanika-ktory-tragicky-zahynul-pred-99-rokmi/

explanation: Štefánik zahynul v máji 1919, keď sa jeho lietadlo zrútilo pri Ivanke pri Dunaji. Je to kúsok od dnešných letiskových dráh, takže letisko nesie jeho meno takmer na mieste jeho posledného letu.
